verdict.rationale: OpenHands' CLI mode is explicitly documented as natural-language driven ('type natural language tasks and receive instant feedback'), with resume, auto-approve, and command palette features, and this is corroborated by an independent probe confirming the CLI docs exist. Missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports of natural-language command success/failure, and clearer detail on how NL parsing/interpretation handles ambiguity or complex multi-step commands.
